releaseNotes:
Fixed: on a laptop the left-hand navigation could not be scrolled. With seventeen entries the list was taller than the screen, so everything below Route Sheet - including the server Start/Stop control and the version footer - was cut off with no way to reach it. The navigation now scrolls, shows a scrollbar when there is more below, and the server control stays pinned at the bottom.

Fixed: the window opened at a fixed 1280x840, which is taller than a common 1366x768 laptop display, so its bottom edge sat off-screen. It now sizes itself to fit the screen it opens on.

Everything from 4.1.0 is included: the synchronization data-loss fix, the History page, customer addresses, and receipt status filters.
